scope: AT&T Stadium candidate point, 5 km radius; publisher-visible calls only
basis: Count-only spatial ArcGIS query; a separate citywide latest-update query checks feed currency.
caution: City public calls are delayed at least 60 minutes and refreshed on a 15-minute cycle. The count is not a current police alert, a stadium incident, a trend, or a threat finding. No incident identities, addresses, categories or coordinates are retained.
